name: @dreamstream/platform-render
description: The DreamStream platform's light renderers: RichDoc to DOCX (docx), DeckSpec to PPTX (a vendored PptxGenJS patched to take data: images only) and Markdown to RichDoc (unified + remark). They never fetch a URL or read a path. Loaded lazily in the browser (services/platformExport.ts) and, from wave 4, in the light engine.
